"anim" : "fadedrop", "dur" : 300 }, "items" : "voidanim" } } } Tatler Report: Wonderful World of Wine Friday, July 6, 2018
James is not only an internationally acclaimed wine critic but also a world traveler and a journalist at heart. With more than three decades of tasting experience, James has visited countless wineries with scenic surrounds and great wines around the world. He is always venturing into new territories and capturing the stories of people, places and tastes of each wine destination. Anyone looking for delicious food and wine, charming landscapes and a warm welcome should check out some of his favorite wine resorts.
As always, we work with Asia Tatler to inform wine consumers, collectors and trade on what James is tasting, as well as our definitive selections each year. This July, Asia Tatler published James’ list of favorite wine resorts around the world. Read the full Tatler article in PDF to learn more about these wine destinations, as well as why these are his top picks. SHARE ON: Comment is required for submission! Leave comment
